evidence_class: mocked: real ledger server processes on a fixture folder, not a live deployment
fixture: Two ledger server subprocesses sharing one tmp_path ledger folder on two reserved ports; a seeded SQLite ledger; the ledger_writer command as a third process
fixture_clock: No expiry or lease timing: the flock lease has no clock; waits are bounded health polls of at most 20 s
cleanup: pytest tmp_path folders and the reserved ports only; every server process is terminated or killed and reaped
mutation_scope: Chat writes on the fixture ledger only; the first server is the single writer of its SQLite file
